title: Ubutunzi bwarohamye mu bwibone
intro: Tekereza uhagaze imbere y’ubutunzi bwinshi cyane ku buryo gutwara imfunguzo gusa byananiza itsinda ry’abantu bakomeye. Hafi yawe, amajwi agushishikariza kwicisha bugufi no kwibuka, ariko ubwibone burushaho kwiyongera kuruta gushima. Bigenda bite iyo impano ibaye ikizamini kandi ubwibone bugashyira mu gaciro umusaruro?
clues: Nari uwo mu bantu ba Musa, ariko narabacumuyeho.
Nahawe ubutunzi bunini cyane ku buryo imfunguzo zabwo zaremereraga itsinda ry'abagabo b'intwari.
Abantu banjye bangiriye inama yo kutishima no gushaka ubuzima bw'imperuka batibagiwe umugabane wanjye muri iyi si.
Navuze ko ibyo nari mfite nabihawe kubera ubumenyi nari mfite gusa.
Nari imbere y'abantu banjye mu mwenda mwiza, kandi abashakaga ubuzima bwo ku isi bifuzaga nk'ubwo nari mfite.
Namizwe n'ubutaka hamwe n'aho nari ndi, kandi nta n'umwe washoboraga kumfasha cyangwa ngo ngire icyo nimarira.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yirataga ubutunzi kandi yanga ineza ya Allah nubwo yamugiriye inama
Yabajije Ibrahim ku bijyanye no gutanga ubuzima n'urupfu
Yayoboye ingabo zirwanya Talut na Dawud
Ibigirwamana byabajwe kugira ngo abantu basenge
Yishe umuvandimwe kubera ishyari kubera igitambo
trial.answer: Yirataga ubutunzi kandi yanga ineza ya Allah nubwo yamugiriye inama

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yarohamye mu nyanja ubwo yakurikiranaga Musa
Yakubiswe n'ibuye ryaturutse ku muhumetso wa Dawidi
Yashenywe n'igisasu gikomeye kubera gukubita ingamiya y'ingore amaguru

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
